name: HYVE
description:
About This Game

A COMPETITIVE CARD GAME BUILT FOR 2V2

HYVE is an online competitive card game where two teams of Hackers battle for control of the network. Build your deck, team up with another Hacker, and coordinate your moves to gain the upper hand over your opponents.

ENTER THE WORLD OF HYVE

In a cyberpunk future, humanity lives under the control of powerful megacorporations fighting over the remnants of a forgotten artificial intelligence: HYVE.

A digital space providing access to its programs has been discovered. To fully exploit it, corporations pair their Hackers together and send them into battle against rival operators.

Your mission: infiltrate their systems, neutralize their C.O.R.E., and recover the data left behind by HYVE.

GAMEPLAY
Tactical 2v2 card-based battles

Team up with another Hacker and face an opposing duo in competitive 2v2 card battles.

Play cards to deploy programs across the network, activate their abilities, and react to enemy actions. Coordinate your moves with your teammate: positioning and decision-making are key to gaining the advantage.

Deckbuilding & Strategy

Build and customize your deck with programs featuring unique abilities. Discover powerful synergies, combine your strategy with your teammate’s, and adapt your playstyle to counter the opposing duo.

Dynamic Match Progression

Matches evolve with every action taken by the four players. Take control of the network, defend your system, and coordinate your attacks to exploit openings and reach the enemy C.O.R.E.

FEATURES

  • Competitive 2v2 multiplayer battles

  • Strategic deckbuilding and card synergies

  • Coordinated strategies and attacks with your teammate

  • Tactical turn-based gameplay

  • Multiple playstyles: aggro, control, or combo

  • Immersive cyberpunk universe

JOIN THE HYVE COMMUNITY

HYVE is being built alongside a community of players passionate about card games, strategy, and competition. Discuss cards, decks, and strategies, find your next teammate, and follow the game’s development with the HYVE community on our Discord.
